## Business
- Name: Milne Family Law
- Lawyer: Warren Milne
- Role: Barrister & Solicitor; negotiator and litigator
- Experience: 30 years in family law
- Phone: +1-705-408-3370
- Email: warren@milnefamilylaw.com
- Service areas: Midland, Penetanguishene, Simcoe County, Ontario and beyond
- Differentiators: Engineer by training; assesses cases legally, financially and emotionally; clear and calm guidance
- Fees: Initial 30-minute consultation $150.00, payable by e-transfer at the time of the consultation; hourly rate thereafter $350.00; some flat-fee services; no Legal Aid certificates
- Consultations: All initial consultations are held online by video; a phone call can be arranged if video isn't possible

General questions: phone (705-408-3370) or the contact form. To arrange an initial consultation, use the Request a Consultation form: suggest three weekday times and Warren confirms one by email or phone within one business day. No pressure; clear next steps.
